verdict.rationale: DeepSeek's API docs explicitly support streaming via a `stream` parameter (deepseek-supp-streaming) and document keep-alive/SSE behavior under load and rate-limit/concurrency specifics (deepseek-supp-concurrency), showing the API supports token-by-token delivery. However, no first-party latency benchmarks or explicit TTFT/sub-second response documentation exists, and community commentary only broadly notes DeepSeek is 'faster' than comparators without concrete timing data. Missing for 10: documented time-to-first-token or full-response latency benchmarks, explicit SLAs/latency guarantees.
